title: Generate multiple short clips (e.g., 13 clips) at 720p in Seedance 2.0 using…
content:
Generate multiple short clips (e.g., 13 clips) at 720p in Seedance 2.0 using Director Mode to build a full music video on a low budget.  
Skip Seedance’s fully automated feature and use semi-automatic mode to manually control framing and pacing.
